title: Add a PostgreSQL migration
steps: Classify the change as additive, transformative, or destructive.
Apply expand-contract whenever versions would be incompatible.
Generate and review the EF Core migration.
Validate indexes, locks, and expected duration.
Run the migration against an ephemeral PostgreSQL in the pipeline.
Document the rollout, the observability, and the logical rollback.
doneWhen: the migration applies to a clean database
the upgrade from the previous state passes
old and new applications stay compatible during the rollout
